patches.entity_key: Irregular present subjunctive of pouvoir, savoir, faire
patches.value: subject pronoun + irregular stem (puiss-/sach-/fass-) + regular subjunctive endings

evidence.notes: Formation 'Irregular stem + regular subjunctive endings'; the same stem serves all six persons, e.g. je puisse / nous puissions.

patches.entity_key: Irregular present subjunctive of être and avoir
patches.value: subject pronoun + irregular stem (soi-/ai-) + irregular endings

evidence.notes: Formation notes both stems and endings are irregular, so no regular pattern applies; e.g. je sois, j'aie, nous soyons, nous ayons.
Formation 'irregular stem + regular future endings'; the endings are identical for all verbs, only the stem of the listed verbs must be memorized.
Formation 'le/la/les + meilleur / pire'; the article agrees with the noun and precedes the irregular superlative form, e.g. le meilleur, la pire.

patches.entity_key: Lequel, laquelle, lesquels, lesquelles after prepositions

evidence.notes: Formation is explicit; à and de contract as auquel/auxquels/auxquelles and duquel/desquels/desquelles, and the pronoun agrees with its antecedent.

patches.entity_key: Main clause verbs followed by que
patches.value: main clause verb + que / où / si + dependent clause in indicative

evidence.notes: Formation is explicit; the reporting verb comes first and the que/où/si clause follows with an indicative verb.
These suffixes (-age, -eau, -ment, -t, -al, -ail, -eil, -isme) predict masculine gender, shown by the preceding article; exceptions such as la page and la nuit are noted.
Formation 'un/une/des -> de/d''; the negated verb is wrapped by ne...pas and the article slot is filled by de (d' before a vowel), e.g. des amis -> pas d'amis.

patches.entity_key: No futur simple after 'si' in future condition
patches.value: si + present tense clause, main clause in futur simple or imperative

evidence.notes: Formation is explicit; the future never appears in the si clause, only in the main clause, and the restriction applies when si means if.
Formation is explicit; où replaces dans lequel / sur lequel / par lequel after a place antecedent, e.g. le magasin où je fais mes courses.
